thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High error rate (5xx/timeout) observed for model variant 'alpha-experimental-3b' across us-west-2. Page sent to @Sam R and @Mia K at 2026-03-15 09:24:16 UTC.
oncall-bot: Impact: ~12% request error rate, spike started ~09:15 UTC, affects Hosted API customers on default routing.
Sam R: seeing it, pulling logs now. error appears to be downstream OOMs on the GPU nodes serving the variant.
Mia K: attaching quick histogram of response times and error codes. Looks like token-gen processes are getting killed mid-stream. :thinking_face:
Sam R: confirmed, kernel crashes on a subset of nodes for alpha-experimental-3b. Suspect quantization path regressions with the new fused-kernel update in runtime-2.1.
Leo T: tagging runtime team. @eng-runtime — is there a known issue with fused kernels + q4_hybrid?
Anya P: notifying customers via status page draft: "We are investigating increased errors for a small subset of model variants. If you see errors, consider pinning to a stable variant." Want me to push?
Sam R: mitigation plan: 1) Stop routing new traffic to alpha-experimental-3b 2) Shift 100% of affected routes to stable-3b-q4 3) Increase per-customer retry throttling to avoid retry storms 4) Monitor for error drop 5) Roll forward a hotfix or rollback runtime change.
Mia K: agree. I'm going to cut traffic at the routing layer now. Using the admin routing API:
```bash
# redirect traffic for matching model id
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route_id":"/v1/generate","match":{"model":"alpha-experimental-3b"},"action":{"type":"redirect","target":"stable-3b-q4","weight":0}}'
```
Mia K: executing... 
deploy-bot: deploy_event: routing-change job 4521 started by Mia K
deploy-bot: routing-change job 4521 succeeded in 12.3s
Mia K: routing change applied. Can folks verify metrics?
Sam R: already seeing error-rate drop on the service-frontend. 5xx down from ~12% to ~2% in 3 minutes. latency stable. :thumbsup:
Anya P: published customer-facing status update: "Traffic has been redirected away from affected experimental variant; customers using default routing may see improved success rates. We will post updates as we validate."
Leo T: runtime team status: we observed increased memory use on q4_hybrid path when sequence length > 1024 combined with KV cache growth. Investigating fused-kernel interaction.
Mia K: secondary mitigation: increasing global retry-backoff and hard-limiting per-key concurrency to 8 for affected routes to prevent user retries from amplifying load. Command run:
```bash
# adjust quota and concurrency
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/quotas -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"selector":{"model":"*"},"action":{"type":"set_concurrency","value":8}}'
```
ops-bot: quota-change job 998 applied by Mia K
Sam R: handing off to Leo for root cause and fix work. I'm going to keep monitoring and will leave the experimental variant disabled until we have a regression test and a patched runtime.
Leo T: taking it, will spin up repro with long sequences + KV cache growth. Oncall rotation note: @Mia K will be primary for the next 30m for any regressions, I'll join for deep debug.
Mia K: capturing runbook steps in #incidents-runbook: disable variant -> redirect -> increase backoff -> notify customers -> collect traces -> revert when fix validated.
Sam R: can we add a temporary feature-flag to block alpha-experimental-3b in the hosted catalog so self-serve customers can't select it?
Mia K: done. feature-flag 'catalog.alpha_experimental_3b.enabled' set to false.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update applied
Anya P: updating status page with timeline and note about temporary disabling of experimental variant and recommended stable alternative.
Sam R: next steps: Leo to produce RCA PR, runtime team to vet fused-kernel tests, prod to keep the variant disabled, and schedule a staged rollback of the routing change only after validated fix.
Leo T: estimated timeline: repro by EOD, fix + CI by tomorrow morning, canary rollout after QA.
Mia K: thanks all. I'll close the paging once error rate sustained <1% for 15m. Will update this thread when closed. :white_check_mark:
(45 minutes later)
Mia K: error rate sustained ~0.7% over 15m window. Closing page, keeping variant disabled and catalog flag off. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-042 with notes.
Sam R: please attach heap profiles and core dumps to the incident ticket.
Leo T: done — uploaded artifacts to the ticket. Moving to postmortem.
Anya P: drafting postmortem, will include customer comms, mitigation timeline, and follow-ups (tests for q4_hybrid, runtime fallback for future fused-kernel issues, better canary thresholds).
Mia K: resolved. Thanks team. :pray:
